name: places_thug_pt1
about: The tutorial's sneak-past thug at his place (docs/specs/0002-npc-ai/record-2026-09-30.md § Witness data; docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Interesting places: the selector, the programs, the wait'). sp_tutorial_1's thug_maker (npc_maker, NPCType npc_VVampire, NPCTargetname thug_1, use_interesting 1, interesting_place_groups 2, vision 540) and the three places pt1 (group_id 2, enabled 1, min_time 30, max_time 60), pt2 and pt3 (group_id 2, enabled 0), verbatim. Spawn makes thug_1 on the maker's origin; his pool is pt1 alone (eligibility 0x102dad60: m_bEnabled +0x57c and the group mask), 63 cm away. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule case 1 step 4 -> 0xff SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE_SETUP -> 0x100 WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE -> SCHED_TROIKA_DO_INTEREST_ACTIVITY, whose wait is RandomFloat(30, 60) (0x102a9f40, m_flWaitFinished +0x5db4); the run arm releases the visit (0x102da600) and the next selection is 0xff again, back to pt1. The player stands at the arena's start, ~1800 cm off and outside 540 units: no enemy, nothing breaks the program.
known_red: 6: the port's ambient executor answers use_interesting instead of the 0xff program
notes: The never on task_do_interest_activity before 30 s pins pt1's min_time (the earliest the visit can end is ~31 s: spawn 0.5 s + walk + 30 s). pt2/pt3 are stood to prove they stay out of the pool (enabled 0): the distance probe at 20 s says he is at pt1.
